traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Daphniphyllaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in racemes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually tepals, rarely absent; fruit drupe; stamens 5 to 12; carpels 2 (-4). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
